title: Packaging messes them up
text:
Packaging messes them up. These are an okay quality. They are very waxy/plasticy looking. The bag they came in bent and folded several of them and they will not go flat despite putting them flat under a heavy book. Several were also ripped and falling apart. They are pretty thick so I think this is why they are so stubborn.

I ended up picking off the ones that were still in decent shape and sticking them here and there in our “living wall” to add some more texture and variety. I’m okay with them this way but a little disappointed as I had hoped it would look better when it arrived.
